{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_clean = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')].copy()

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rate difference within each group
# Compute conversion rate for each channel within each segment
stratified_rates = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) within each segment
# First, pivot to get email and paid_search rates per segment
crosstab = stratified_rates.pivot(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='mean')

# Compute difference: email - paid_search
diff_by_segment = crosstab['email'] - crosstab['paid_search']

# Also get counts for context
counts = stratified_rates.pivot(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='count')

print("Conversion rates by segment:")
print(crosstab)
print("\nDifference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(diff_by_segment)
print("\nCounts per segment and channel:")
print(counts)"}
